The '''Overflux Capacitor''' is an {{Epic}} item. It is a {{Odds|RNGesus}} drop from the {{SlayerTier|IV}} [[Sven Packmaster]]. The player must have at least {{CollectionLink|Wolf Slayer 7}}. It is used in the crafting recipe for the {{Item|Overflux Power Orb}}. 

== Obtaining ==
=== Mob Drops ===
An '''Overflux Capacitor''' can drop from the {{Stier|4}} [[Sven Packmaster]] if the player has reached {{Coll|Wolf Slayer LVL 7}}. It has a {{Green|0.0385%}} (approximately {{Green|1/2,597}}) base chance to drop from the boss.

=== Raffle of the Century ===
'''Overflux Capacitor''' can also be obtained as a {{Gold|'''MEDIUM'''}} reward from [[Raffle of the Century]].
